# Dataset and job locations
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/locations
#
# Each script creates the datasets it uses, named unverified_locations_*, which stay in the
# project after the scripts run. The queries name no location, so BigQuery infers each job's.
#
# The documentation says that a job fails when it uses a dataset outside its location, but not
# with which message, nor how the location of a script is inferred.

# The message for a query that uses two locations.

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `region-eu`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA, `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA
?>

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_locations_eu OPTIONS (location = 'EU');
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_locations_eu.t AS SELECT 1 AS x;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM unverified_locations_eu.t, `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA
?>

# A single region does not match the multi-region it lies in.

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA, `region-us-central1`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA
?>

# SCHEMATA without a region qualifier is the US region's, also in a job elsewhere.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_locations_eu OPTIONS (location = 'EU');
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_locations_eu.t AS SELECT 1 AS x;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM unverified_locations_eu.t, INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA
?>

# How the location option of CREATE SCHEMA is spelled once stored.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_locations_eu_lower OPTIONS (location = 'eu');
SELECT location FROM `region-eu`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA WHERE schema_name = 'unverified_locations_eu_lower'
?>

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_locations_tokyo OPTIONS (location = 'ASIA-NORTHEAST1');
SELECT location FROM `region-asia-northeast1`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA WHERE schema_name = 'unverified_locations_tokyo'
?>

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_locations_eu OPTIONS (location = 'EU');
SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT(ddl, r'location="[^"]*"') FROM `region-eu`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA WHERE schema_name = 'unverified_locations_eu'
?>

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_locations_tokyo OPTIONS (location = 'asia-northeast1');
SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT(ddl, r'location="[^"]*"') FROM `region-asia-northeast1`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA WHERE schema_name = 'unverified_locations_tokyo'
?>

# A location BigQuery does not have.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_locations_nowhere OPTIONS (location = 'nowhere');
SELECT 1
?>

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `region-nowhere`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA
?>

# Whether a region qualifier is compared without case.

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `REGION-EU`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA WHERE schema_name = 'unverified_locations_eu'
?>

# Where a script runs: CREATE SCHEMA with a location settles it, and a dataset created without one
# takes it.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_locations_eu OPTIONS (location = 'EU');
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_locations_eu_implicit;
SELECT location FROM `region-eu`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA WHERE schema_name = 'unverified_locations_eu_implicit'
?>

# A script whose statements name datasets of two locations.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_locations_eu OPTIONS (location = 'EU');
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA
?>

# A dataset that CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS names in another location than the job's.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_locations_eu OPTIONS (location = 'EU');
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_locations_eu OPTIONS (location = 'US');
SELECT 1
?>

# ALTER SCHEMA cannot move a dataset.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_locations_eu OPTIONS (location = 'EU');
ALTER SCHEMA unverified_locations_eu SET OPTIONS (location = 'EU');
SELECT 1
?>

# A view in one location that reads a table in another.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_locations_eu OPTIONS (location = 'EU');
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_locations_us OPTIONS (location = 'US');
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_locations_us.t AS SELECT 1 AS x;
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW unverified_locations_eu.v AS SELECT x FROM unverified_locations_us.t;
SELECT 1
?>
